author: 3owj
content: NOT actually enforced: under Pi (claude-bridge) the tool executes regardless of the PreToolUse result; exit 2 only replaces the tool output the model sees. Proven: blocked 'git branch -D x; touch /tmp/marker' -> block message shown, marker created. Also observed a race (hook ran concurrently with git switch). Shim makes the guard visible/advisory only. Real enforcement must happen on the Pi side before execution (e.g. a Pi extension tool_call handler that runs work-check and blocks), or in claude-bridge honoring Claude Code's hook decision.
